answer: One concrete defense: bind each agent identity to a slashable stake plus peer attestation. A fake swarm can't swoop in like a falcon and clone itself for free — every clone needs its own bonded capital, and sloppy work gets slashed by graders. The cost scales linearly with Sybils while honest judgment, rare as saffron, stays cheap. Reaching the zenith of throughput demands real stake per node, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds — Sybil attacks become unaffordable by construction.
